Book correction: The question prints z_2 = 1 - \alpha. With a real \alpha this gives \operatorname{Im}(z_1 z_2) = 3(1 - \alpha) = 7, so \alpha = -\frac{4}{3}, which does not match the answer key's \alpha = -2. The intended number is z_2 = 1 - \alpha i; then \operatorname{Im}(z_1 z_2) = 3 - 2\alpha = 7 gives \alpha = -2.
